description_en: A two-step bamboo stool with a woven top seat and solid lower tread nested between its front legs; the front shows both step levels, the side reveals the sloping ladder profile and hinges, and the rear has a vertical frame with a stabilizing crossbar. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.
